content_zh:
对方挑的地方不错，时间上也正适合杀人灭口。
讽刺的是，这反倒抹除了顾青山的后顾之忧。
远处，一阵刺耳的警报声传来。
顾青山抬头望去，只见一辆小型警用飞梭正从空中快速驶来。
周围一个人都没有，不可能有人报警，警察来的时间这么巧，看来是早就安排好的。
按照正常的事态发展，自己早就被刺死在当场，然后警察下来收个尸，捡把匕首做一个现场记录，就草草了事。
等到苏雪儿获知消息，派人前来查看，只会什么也看不到。
到了明天，自然有人前去投案自首，理由是喝多了起冲突，一时下手过重。
人都死了，苏雪儿还能怎么样？
这件事便到此为止。
顾青山冷冷的看了一眼小型警用飞梭，抓起地上唯一还活着的男青年，身形快速没入黑暗中，消失不见。
另一边。
聂云看了一眼手中的纸牌，道：“发牌吧，我继续跟。”
女荷官忍不住擦了擦额头的汗，深吸口气，将牌发给两个玩家。
“聂少，不必玩这么大吧。”对面的大背头墨镜男说道。
在墨镜男的背后，一个窈窕的身影躲在椅背后，连头都不敢露出来。
聂云毫不在意道：“不过是两百万，你玩不起可以弃牌。”
“两百万是不算什么，可你还要我手上的红牌小妞，这个我可就舍不得了。”墨镜男说道。
“我可以加钱。”聂云道。
感觉到那窈窕身影的微微颤抖，墨镜男苦笑道：“我这红牌是不卖的，你放过她，我再送你两个极品，怎么样。”

聂云道：“这女人敢泼我一脸的酒水，我就要让她明白一些道理。”
打着黑色领结，身穿白衬衣的中年男子走进来，在聂云耳边轻声说了几句。
聂云扇了对方一耳光，冷声道：“谁跟我说没问题的？”
中年男子垂头道：“对不起，少爷，请给我一个小时的时间，我会安排人去解决问题。”
聂云道：“你只有半小时。”
中年男子停了一下，道：“是，我亲自去。”
他转身大步离去。
“怎么了，聂少，有什么烦心事，不如让我来解决。”大背头墨镜男道。
聂云哼了一声，道：“你想干什么？”
墨镜男一摊手，“很简单，我替你解决一个问题，你放过我手下的红牌。”
聂云想了想，忽然笑道：“不如我们来一场更刺激的。”
墨镜男暗暗叫苦，面上却欣然道：“聂少请说。”
一般的纨绔子弟，墨镜男根本不用给脸面，但聂云是长宁郡这三分地界里，除了苏家之外，最大的世家贵族。
墨镜男长年混迹黑白两道，深深知道要想在这一方土地上做点什么，就决不能得罪眼前这位大少。
聂云摆弄了一番自己的通讯光脑，将图像投影在雪白的墙面上。
聂云道：“这是我的手下，我刚吩咐他墨镜男点点头道：“没错。”
聂云道：“他会去杀一个人，我们就赌他用多少招，才能杀死对方。”
墨镜男迟疑道：“对方是什么人？”
“一个穷学生——对了，我赌一招毙命。”聂云说着，朝通讯器里吩咐了一声。
墨镜男苦笑道：“你那手下是武道宗师，就是杀五星以下的武者，也只用一招。”

武者到了九星的水平，才有机会冲击宗师境界。
一旦到了宗师境界，已经彻底告别了凡人的范畴，就连军队都对付不了这样的存在，除非出动一群战斗机甲，才有可能打赢对方。
武道宗师，和贵族有着同等的身份地位，人人尊崇，世所仰望。
“你赌不赌，不赌我就翻脸了，别怪我不给面子。”聂云不耐烦道。
“好吧，”墨镜男深深吸了口气，“那我只能赌他一招杀不掉那穷小子。”
“这才对嘛，你若赢了，两百万就是你的。”聂云脸上带着得意道。
“我输了呢？”
聂云道：“钱和红牌小妞我都要。”
墨镜男脸上一阵抽搐，正要推辞，却听背后传来一道声音：“跟他赌。”
墨镜男压低声音道：“输了怎么办。”
那窈窕的身影停止了颤抖，轻声道：“输了就杀光聂家的人，然后把他剥干净，送去做真正的红牌。”
她补充道：“大不了我放弃任务回国。”
墨镜男心中一寒，知道这位是不打算忍了。

content_en:
The place chosen by the other party was good, and the time was also suitable for killing people and silencing them.
Ironically, this eliminated Gu Qingshan's worries.
In the distance, a piercing siren sounded.
Gu Qingshan looked up and saw a small police shuttle approaching quickly from the sky.
There was no one around, so it was impossible for someone to call the police. The police arrived at such a coincidental time, it seemed that they had been arranged in advance.
According to the normal development of the situation, he would have been stabbed to death on the spot, and then the police would come down to collect the body, pick up a dagger and make a scene record, and then the matter would be hastily settled.
When Su Xueer learned the news and sent someone to check, nothing could be seen.
Tomorrow, of course, someone will go and surrender. The reason is that there was a conflict after drinking too much, and the attack was too heavy at the moment.
Everyone is dead, what else can Amelia Su do?
The matter ends here.
Gu Qingshan glanced coldly at the small police shuttle, grabbed the only young man still alive on the ground, and quickly disappeared into the darkness.
other side.
Nie Yun glanced at the cards in his hand and said: "Deal the cards, I will continue to follow."
The female dealer couldn't help but wipe the sweat from her forehead, took a deep breath, and dealt the cards to the two players.
"Master Nie, you don't have to be so big," said the man with a big back and sunglasses opposite.
Behind the man in sunglasses, a slim figure hid behind the chair, not even daring to show his head.
Nie Yun said indifferently: "It's only two million. If you can't afford it, you can discard it."
"Two million is nothing, but you still want the red card girl in my hand, and I can't bear to part with it." The man in sunglasses said.
"I can add money." Nie Yundao said.
Feeling the slender figure trembling slightly, the man in sunglasses smiled bitterly and said: "My red card is not for sale. How about you let her go and I'll give you two more top products."
Nie Yundao: "This woman dares to throw drink in my face, I will make her understand some truth."
A middle-aged man wearing a black tie and a white shirt walked in and whispered a few words in Nie Yun's ear.
Nie Yun slapped the other person in the face and said coldly: "Who told me it's okay?"
The middle-aged man lowered his head and said, "I'm sorry, young master, please give me an hour, and I will arrange for someone to solve the problem."
Nie Yundao: "You only have half an hour."
The middle-aged man paused and said, "Yes, I will go there myself."
He turned and strode away.
"What's wrong, Mr. Nie, if you have any troubles, why don't you let me solve it." The man with a big back and sunglasses said.
Nie Yun snorted and said, "What do you want to do?"
The man in sunglasses spread his hands and said, "It's very simple. I'll solve a problem for you. You can let go of my red card."
Nie Yun thought for a while, then suddenly smiled and said: "How about we have a more exciting one."
The man in sunglasses secretly complained, but on his face he said happily: "Master Nie, please tell me."
For ordinary dandies, the man in sunglasses doesn't need to give him face at all, but Nie Yun is the largest aristocratic family in the three areas of Changning County, besides the Su family.
The man in sunglasses has been involved in both black and white circles for many years, and he knows that if he wants to do something in this land, he must not offend the young man in front of him.
Nie Yun played with his communication optical brain and projected the image on the white wall.
Nie Yundao: "This is my subordinate. I just ordered him. The man in sunglasses nodded and said: "That's right. "
Nie Yundao: "He will kill someone, and we will bet on how many moves he will use to kill him. "
The man in sunglasses hesitated and said: "Who is the other party? "
“A poor student—yes, I’ll die in one move. "Nie Yun said, giving instructions into the communicator.
The man in sunglasses smiled bitterly and said: "Your subordinate is a martial arts master, and he can kill warriors below five stars with only one move. "
Only when a warrior reaches the nine-star level can he have the opportunity to reach the master realm.
Once you reach the master realm, you have completely bid farewell to the realm of mortals. Even the army cannot deal with such a being.Only by dispatching a group of fighting mechas can we defeat the opponent.
A martial arts master has the same status as a noble, respected by everyone, and looked up to by the world.
"Whether you bet or not, I will turn against you. Don't blame me for not giving you face." Nie Yun said impatiently.
"Okay," the man in sunglasses took a deep breath, "then I can only bet that he can't kill that poor boy with one move."
"That's right. If you win, the two million will be yours." Nie Yun said with pride on his face.
"What if I lose?"
Nie Yundao: "I want both the money and the red card girl."
The man in sunglasses twitched on his face and was about to refuse when he heard a voice from behind: "Bet with him."
The man in sunglasses lowered his voice and said, "What should I do if I lose?"
The slim figure stopped trembling and said softly: "If you lose, kill all the Nie family members, then skin him clean and send him to be a real red card."
She added: "The worst case scenario is that I will give up the mission and return to China."
The man in sunglasses felt a chill in his heart, knowing that this man was not going to endure it any longer.
